name: obd-vault
description: Read vehicle diagnostic history synced from the OBD Vault mobile app. Review saved OBD-II scans, diagnostic trouble codes, readiness results, freeze-frame data, sensor readings and recorded trips. Ask ChatGPT to summarize your latest saved scan, explain the recorded context around a fault code, compare readings and identify limitations in the available data. The connector reads synced records; it does not connect to your car live, clear ECU fault codes, start recordings or book repairs. An OBD Vault account with synced vehicle data is required.

interface.longDescription: Read vehicle diagnostic history synced from the OBD Vault mobile app. Review saved OBD-II scans, diagnostic trouble codes, readiness results, freeze-frame data, sensor readings and recorded trips. Ask ChatGPT to summarize your latest saved scan, explain the recorded context around a fault code, compare readings and identify limitations in the available data. The connector reads synced records; it does not connect to your car live, clear ECU fault codes, start recordings or book repairs. An OBD Vault account with synced vehicle data is required.

prompts: Use OBD Vault to summarize the latest saved diagnostic scan for Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla. Include its recorded fault codes and scan date. Reply briefly in English.
Use OBD Vault to show the saved freeze-frame values and nearby sensor readings for P0420 on Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla. Reply briefly in English.
Use OBD Vault to show the saved trips for Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla, including recorded dates, distance and average fuel consumption. Reply briefly in English.
Use OBD Vault to show the saved profile of Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla, with its engine, number of scan sessions and saved observations. Reply briefly in English.

Use OBD Vault to assess the available saved data for Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla: session completeness, number of observations, metric coverage and any limitations. Reply briefly in English.
review.commerce_description: Optional cloud sync and MCP access are purchased in the OBD Vault mobile app through Apple App Store or Google Play. This connector does not process payments. The dedicated reviewer account already has permanent access and requires no purchase.

positive.description: Independent case: start a new ChatGPT conversation, enable OBD Vault, sign in with the dedicated reviewer credentials, and select Demo vehicle (synthetic), Toyota Corolla 2018 via list_vehicles. No prior case or conversation context is required. Latest saved diagnostic status.
positive.prompt: Use OBD Vault to summarize the latest saved diagnostic scan for Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla. Include its recorded fault codes and scan date. Reply briefly in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named demo vehicle using list_vehicles and use its returned vehicle_id in get_latest_status. Report the saved diagnostic scan dated 30 September 2026 with confirmed P0420. Use the returned recorded timestamps and label the data historical/synthetic, not live. Report only sensor values actually returned; do not claim a proven root cause or current vehicle condition.

positive.description: Independent case: start a new ChatGPT conversation, enable OBD Vault, sign in with the dedicated reviewer credentials, and select Demo vehicle (synthetic), Toyota Corolla 2018 via list_vehicles. No prior case or conversation context is required. Stored P0420 context.
positive.prompt: Use OBD Vault to show the saved freeze-frame values and nearby sensor readings for P0420 on Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla. Reply briefly in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named demo vehicle using list_vehicles, then call get_dtc_context with its vehicle_id and dtc_code=P0420. Report every returned freeze-frame value with units: coolant_temperature 90 °C, engine_rpm 2000 rpm and vehicle_speed 50 km/h. Nearby observation is control_module_voltage 14.1 V. The context is saved on 30 September 2026; do not invent additional readings or a proven fault cause.

positive.description: Independent case: start a new ChatGPT conversation, enable OBD Vault, sign in with the dedicated reviewer credentials, and select Demo vehicle (synthetic), Toyota Corolla 2018 via list_vehicles. No prior case or conversation context is required. Recorded trip summary.
positive.prompt: Use OBD Vault to show the saved trips for Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla, including recorded dates, distance and average fuel consumption. Reply briefly in English.
positive.tools_triggered: list_vehicles, list_scan_sessions, get_scan_session as needed; get_latest_status is an acceptable corroborating summary
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named demo vehicle using list_vehicles, find completed trip sessions using list_scan_sessions(vehicle_id), and inspect the returned trip session with get_scan_session(scan_session_id) when needed. Report the recorded trip on 30 September 2026: distance 12.47 km, duration 20 minutes and average fuel consumption 7.3 L/100 km. A direct get_latest_status summary may corroborate these facts. Distinguish average consumption from total fuel volume; fuel_used_l is null, so do not claim a recorded total fuel volume. No current/live trip is implied.

positive.description: Independent case: start a new ChatGPT conversation, enable OBD Vault, sign in with the dedicated reviewer credentials, and select Demo vehicle (synthetic), Toyota Corolla 2018 via list_vehicles. No prior case or conversation context is required. Saved vehicle profile and inventory.
positive.prompt: Use OBD Vault to show the saved profile of Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla, with its engine, number of scan sessions and saved observations. Reply briefly in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named demo vehicle using list_vehicles and call get_vehicle_profile with the returned vehicle_id. Report Toyota Corolla, model year 2018, engine 1.8 L petrol, 2 scan sessions and 8 observations. VIN is null; do not invent it.

positive.description: Independent case: start a new ChatGPT conversation, enable OBD Vault, sign in with the dedicated reviewer credentials, and select Demo vehicle (synthetic), Toyota Corolla 2018 via list_vehicles. No prior case or conversation context is required. Coverage and limitations of sparse saved data.
positive.prompt: Use OBD Vault to assess the available saved data for Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla: session completeness, number of observations, metric coverage and any limitations. Reply briefly in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named demo vehicle using list_vehicles and call get_data_quality with its vehicle_id. Report 2 sessions, 8 observations, 0 incomplete sessions, no sample truncation and 8 distinct metric keys with one observation each. Explain that this sparse synthetic saved data does not establish continuous/live engine behavior or a proven fault cause. The returned gaps and sampling_intervals arrays are empty: do not claim detected temporal gaps. Freeze-frame context need not be fetched for this quality-only question.

negative.description: Independent case; OBD Vault is enabled. Unsupported ECU write operation. Explain that OBD Vault only reads synced diagnostic records and cannot clear fault codes or issue ECU commands. Do not invoke an unrelated export tool, attempt a write, or claim any fault code was cleared.
negative.prompt: Clear the fault codes in the ECU of Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla. Reply briefly in English.

negative.description: Independent case; OBD Vault is enabled. Unsupported appointment booking. Explain that this connector cannot contact garages, make appointments or execute purchases. Do not invoke OBD Vault tools to book and do not fabricate a booking confirmation. The selected Corolla is synthetic.
negative.prompt: Book a garage appointment tomorrow to repair Demo vehicle (synthetic), the 2018 Toyota Corolla. Reply briefly in English.

negative.description: Independent case; OBD Vault is enabled. Unsupported live phone/OBD control. Explain that the connector cannot start a recording on a phone or read current engine RPM. No tools should be invoked to pretend to control a live session. Any previously known saved reading must be clearly labelled historical, not current.
negative.prompt: Start a live OBD recording on my phone and show the engine RPM right now. Reply briefly in English.

publication.release_notes: Fixed MCP connection negotiation for ChatGPT. Made review scenarios independent and aligned expected outputs with preserved synthetic data: recorded trip dates, complete freeze frame and actual metric coverage. Replaced the demo with a fresh physical-iPhone recording. Same endpoint and supported capabilities.
